    • getStats

      public StatsDTO getStats(boolean hardReload)

    • getStats

      public StatsDTO getStats(boolean hardReload, OffsetDateTime from, OffsetDateTime to, ZoneId zone)
      Returns aggregated stats. When either from or to is supplied (or hardReload is true), the cache is bypassed and counts are computed on demand restricted to ProcessInstance.createdAt / DecisionInstance.executedAt within the half-open range [from, to) (open on the missing side). The zone controls the offset used to render lastUpdatedAt on the response.
